race.comment: BLANC VISAGE (13) started favourite but was edged out by HEART OF THE MED when fresh from a spell over 1100m at Murray Bridge last start. Maps beautifully behind what should be a breakneck pace. Up a little in class but drops two kilos and can easily finish right over the top of these. BOYD (1) led all the way to win a Class 2 when resuming over this course and distance two runs back. Tackled a better race last time and did a fine job to stick on for second at the end of 1000m at Murray Bridge. Perfectly drawn to play a key role again. VIRTUAL ILLUSION (5) is back after a four-month spell. Competitive last prep at Listed and Group Two level. Lightly raced four-year-old with the talent to test this field. HEART OF THE MED (9) made it two from two this prep, and three from four overall, when she just denied BLANC VISAGE at Murray Bridge recently. Biggest test today but difficult to knock.
